snippet.title: Yes Comrade Announcement Trailer - Coming December 16th 2025
snippet.description:
✅ Wishlist Yes Comrade on Steam: 👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198400/Yes_Comrade/

Yes Comrade is a 1 - 4 player cooperative survival sandbox where you and your fellow Comrades are re-assigned to a remote sea outpost. Guard the great Belegovskain coastline, process the ships, keep the Supreme Leader happy, and try not to think too hard about what happens on the island…

Coming to Steam Early Access December 16th 2025!

FEATURES

🫡 Run a remote military sea outpost for the glorious nation of Belegovska
🛳️ Inspect, interrogate and approve any ships based on an daily evolving ruleset
💰 Track your quota and gain social credits to buy essentials to survive
🖼️ Clean, rebuild and decorate your outpost with furniture, wallpaper and the finest propaganda
🔎 Track strange anomalies and report number stations to keep the state safe

Just remember Comrade, whatever happens on this outpost you need to ensure our Supreme Leader will log it as a successful venture…
